# Contract: verification-before-completion

Third-party skill from [obra/superpowers](https://github.com/obra/superpowers) (MIT, Jesse Vincent), skills-bundle snapshot 2026-11-13. SumitCraft set the folder name and the description so the skill fills one gap (Prove a claim of done by running the check). The method is upstream. Category: engineering. Kind: guidance-only (no scripts by design).

## Purpose
Run the verification command and read the output before claiming that work is done, fixed, or passing.

## Use it for
- "don't say it passes until you run it"
- "prove this fix before you call it done"

## Not for
- a benchmark write-up (benchmark-honestly)
- a visual before/after (design-critique)

## Accepted inputs
A claim that is about to be made, and the command that would prove or sink it.

## Deliverables
The command, its output, and a claim that matches that output.
